notes: The load-in time now reaches the quote. It only ever went to the prep sheet and the confirmation, so typing one and looking at the quote showed nothing. It joins the times line as Load-in 12:00 - Call 14:00 - Show 18:30-02:00 - Wrap 04:00, and stating a load-in on its own is enough to bring that line in. Its label is now just Load-in, which is why it sat lower than the two boxes beside it: the old wording wrapped onto a second line at a third of the row and pushed the box down. What it's for has moved into the hint underneath. Two fixes found while checking it: the crew booking email could show two different call times, its own and a derived one, so the new call time now follows the crew call when you haven't set one; and the confirmation listed the load-in twice once the times line carried it.
